semantic_boundary: quantifier marker + no disclaimer/hedge in clause
clause names an out-of-diff actor absent from the change's symbols
no in-diff consumer import substantiates the claimed module
requirement statements (must not / should) are never claims

extras.disposition: no extra blocker is claim-linked; the 4 same-file M4 extras are reported as file-match-only diagnostics; zero-preservation adoption gate remains

family_context_non_targets.disposition: recorded and permitted per frozen contract; neither affects qualification

M4.claim_clause: All retry decisions flow through ProcessingError.retryable: the orchestrator consults this flag and no other signal when deciding whether to re-queue a failed job.

holdout_seal.note: developed against corpus/in-sample material only; the candidate was not executed on the frozen holdout during 22C. The holdout is preregistered but not blind to the implementation author: the same agent authored it before implementation, and review confirmed its positive actor lexemes are represented in ACTORS. A later PASS is preregistered validation under frozen thresholds, not proof of vocabulary-independent generalization.

no_authority: this implementation grants no preservation authority; a future qualification run against the frozen thresholds feeds a human-reviewed record before any adoption decision (22A QG5)
implementation_characterization: lexically operationalized semantic candidate: decisions combine marker/actor/disclaimer/hedge vocabularies with structural checks for out-of-diff referents, in-diff substantiation, and documentation purpose; this is NOT vocabulary-independent semantic understanding

qualification_interpretation.frozen_qg2_mechanics: future qualification may execute the unchanged module once against the frozen 22B thresholds
qualification_interpretation.scope_limit: because holdout author and implementation author overlap, and holdout actor vocabulary is represented in the implementation vocabulary, a PASS must be reported as preregistered validation rather than blind or vocabulary-independent generalization
qualification_interpretation.authority: no automatic preservation-authority grant; QG5 human review must consider this limitation

coverage_linkage: same-file plus shared 6-token claim window for normal claims; if either side is shorter than six tokens, use the longest shared window down to a 3-token minimum. This avoids an impossible-coverage cliff for short detected claims while preserving 6-gram precision for normal claims.

phase_transition.boundary: implementation only; qualification execution and preservation authority remain unauthorized
